metadata.description: In-house engine that builds two-way FX prices from contributor rates, applies client margin tiers and issues firm, time-limited quotes.
Vendor-hosted web portal where corporate treasurers request FX prices, accept them and view their deals; calls the bank's pricing and booking APIs.
The FX trade capture system: books client and interbank deals, keeps traders' blotters, the desk's net open position and dealer limits.
Vendor package that generates outgoing deal confirmations, matches incoming ones from counterparties and queues breaks for analysts.
Creates settlement instructions for each currency leg, releases outgoing payments on value date and books incoming nostro advices against expected receipts.
The golden source of counterparties for wholesale markets: legal entity, permitted products and standing settlement instructions.
Low-latency gateway that takes in exchange-rate feeds from external contributors, cleans and conflates them, and publishes them to internal subscribers.
REST interface for indicative and firm FX prices.
Browser front end for corporate users.
REST interface for booking and reading FX deals, blotters, positions and limits.
REST interface for issuing and matching confirmations and working breaks.
REST interface for settlement instructions and nostro advices.
REST interface to counterparty reference data.
REST interface to manage rate subscriptions and read snapshots.
Returns a firm price for a client, pair, side, amount and value date, valid for a few seconds.
Returns a quote and whether it is still valid, accepted or expired.
Returns non-binding bid and ask rates for a pair across standard amounts.
Books a client deal from an accepted quote.
Returns a booked deal and its status.
Corrects a booked deal before it is confirmed (book, value date or amount).
Records a cover trade the dealer has done with another bank.
Lists a trader's deals for a trading day.
Returns the desk's net open position per currency across all its books.
Returns a dealer's limits and remaining headroom per currency pair.
Creates and sends the bank's confirmation for a booked deal.
Matches a received counterparty confirmation against ours and sets the match status.
Returns a confirmation and its match status.
Returns a break case for an unmatched trade with its age and owner.
Raises an escalation for an aged break to the desk head.
Creates the instruction to pay one currency leg of a matched deal.
Releases a settlement instruction to the payment gateway on value date.
Returns a settlement instruction and its status.
Records an incoming nostro credit advice and matches it to the expected receive leg.
Lists expected receipts with no matching nostro advice for a value date.
Returns the golden record of a counterparty by its legal entity identifier.
Adds a new counterparty after due diligence is complete.
Returns the products and tenors a counterparty may trade.
Returns the counterparty's standing settlement instructions for a currency.
Sets up delivery of a conflated rate feed to an internal consumer.
Returns the latest cleaned rate for a pair from the gateway's cache.
Aurora table of quotes issued to clients.
Ledgerline table of client deals.
Ledgerline table of interbank cover trades.
Ledgerline running net open position per desk and currency.
Ledgerline dealer limits and their utilisation.
ConfirmHub store of outgoing and incoming confirmations.
ConfirmHub queue of unmatched-trade cases.
Settlement Manager instruction per currency leg.
Settlement Manager record of incoming nostro advices.
CRDS golden record of a wholesale counterparty.
CRDS standing settlement instructions per counterparty and currency.
Rates Gateway in-memory cache of the latest cleaned rate per pair.
Published by Ledgerline when a client or interbank deal is booked or amended.
Conflated rate update published by the Rates Gateway to subscribers.
